campaign_focus: IShowSpeed playing GTA 6 must be the focus: his biggest reactions, screaming, laughing fits, rage, shock, chaos, fails and discoveries. Titles and captions must describe exactly what happened and name IShowSpeed. Never portray him negatively, no drama or rage-bait framing. Skip just-chatting, sponsor reads, donations, menus, quiet driving, nudity, drug talk and slurs. Also prioritise: funny GAME BUGS and glitches (NPCs or physics breaking, cars flying), big STORY moments and twists (with the streamer's reaction, no long cutscenes), the streamer's biggest REACTIONS, and moments where CHAT EXPLODES (<<CHAT Nx>> spikes).
